A.angular_field: Keep each exact frozen acquired5–120arcmin field; no new FOV, crop, centering adaptation or crop based on class/appearance.
A.known_limitation: Class-associated angular coverage, source pixel scale, field grain, target extent and background remain visible. Mandatory B/metadata/background controls and FOV-stratified reporting are not optional.
A.name: catalogue_adaptive_full_field
A.output: 3x224x224 float32 using common normalization; no padding.
A.raw_view: All512x512 original scaled DN pixels in each aligned band; quantiles estimated on the full512x512 view.
A.resize: Exact separable area-overlap averaging512→224 after intensity and optional D4 augmentation. Output pixel(j,i) spans input-edge coordinates [j*512/224,(j+1)*512/224]×[i*512/224,(i+1)*512/224]; weight each native pixel by intersection area and divide by output-pixel area. No unspecified library interpolation default.
A.scientific_estimand: Whole available adaptive astronomical fields, with substantially preserved structure/context. Not a scale-neutral or morphology-only experiment.

B.PSF_scope: Fixed added angular Gaussian and fixed output sampling control pixel-scale/FOV channels, but do not claim equal measured original photographic PSF or complete removal of original sampling/grain clues.
B.area_sampling: For each common output pixel, use fixed8x8 midpoint quadrature over its TAN-plane pixel area. Map each sample via analytic TAN forward/inverse WCS into the smoothed source; bilinear interpolation from four native pixel centres; arithmetic mean of64 samples. All Gaussian and interpolation support must lie inside original source. No per-case kernel/crop repair.
B.common_WCS: TAN ICRS at frozen catalogue RA/Dec, CRPIX1=CRPIX2=8.5, CDELT1=-15/3600,CDELT2=+15/3600deg/pixel; pixel outer edges0.5..16.5. No per-object adaptation.
B.effective_samples: Only16x16 spatial samples. Added smoothing and area sampling further reduce fine detail;224x224 is an interface shape, not recovered resolution.
B.name: common_angular_field_and_sampling_control
B.prefilter: Each raw scaled source DN band is smoothed on its native local TAN plane with a separable normalized Gaussian of added FWHM15arcsec. sigma=15/(2*sqrt(2*ln(2))*source_scale_arcsec_per_pixel); integer support radius=ceil(4*sigma). Weights exp(-k^2/(2*sigma^2)) for k=-radius..radius, normalized to sum1. No source-edge padding; evaluate only fully supported pixels.
B.resize: After optional D4 on the16x16 lattice, repeat each cell exactly14times in each spatial dimension to224x224. Nearest replication has no new independent information.
B.role: Mandatory independently reported image control if A is primary; if B is primary, A is a predeclared contextual comparator. No choice is made after accuracy or test outcomes.
B.scientific_estimand: Central4arcmin appearance at coarse common angular sampling; large targets/context are truncated and small targets may be unresolved.
B.stretch_after_common_view: Compute per-band p01/p99 on the16x16 raw common view, then common asinh transformation. Never estimate B intensity parameters on the original adaptive full field.

WCS_checks.band_alignment: Identical dimensions and projection/frame; all band-to-blue sky-to-pixel mappings at catalogue centre, four pixel-centre corners and geometric centre differ<=1e-6pixel. No alignment repair or per-candidate reprojection fallback.
WCS_checks.catalogue_centre: Reference position<=1arcsec from frozen catalogue coordinates, requested sky point<=1pixel from geometric centre; independently verify TAN roundtrip<=1e-6pixel.
WCS_checks.failure: Stop materialization and preserve diagnosis; do not drop/relabel/repair an E-eligible object.
WCS_checks.frozen_request_FOV: Check returned CDELT magnitude against degrees(2*tan(radians(request_FOV_deg)/2)/512), relative1e-9 / absolute1e-12deg/pixel.
WCS_checks.matrix: Finite invertible CD or PC/CDELT; north-up east-left, off-diagonals absolute sum<1e-12deg/pixel, CD11<0, CD22>0.

augmentation.draw: SHA256 UTF8 Dataset-v2F|augment|2026102303|physical_object_id|zero_based_epoch; first8 digest bytes interpreted big-endian unsigned, modulo8.
augmentation.new_v2F_role: Prospective augmentation stream, not an inherited split or training seed.
augmentation.operation: For code0..7: horizontal mirror iff code>=4, then counterclockwise np.rot90 k=code%4 on the spatial axes. Identical code for all bands and controls of an object. Apply on512 lattice for A,16 lattice for B, before final sizing.

intensity.arithmetic: CPU float64 until final tensor cast; no uint8 conversion or JPEG/PNG input.
intensity.normalization: After spatial resizing: (u-0.5)/0.5 independently in each channel. Fixed constants, not ImageNet RGB statistics or fitted all-data means.
intensity.physical_limit: Independent band stretches intentionally sacrifice absolute flux and calibrated colour ratios. Photographic DN is not common flux calibration; no physical SED/colour claim.
intensity.quantiles: Independently per band on the defined raw view. Sort finite values; h=(n-1)*q; linear interpolation between floor(h),ceil(h), q=0.01 and0.99. No class/label, training-wide or test-fitted stretch parameters.

invalid_pixels.current_evidence: Cached frozen C header/pixel checks for the E370 pool meet finite/nondegenerate conditions; future materialization must revalidate actual FITS independently.
invalid_pixels.definition: Nonfinite native/scaled values or native integer BLANK; apply FITS scaling before intensity transformation.
invalid_pixels.policy: Any declared invalid pixel needed by a recipe stops the whole materialization gate. No imputation, inpainting, variable mask channel, object-specific crop or silent removal.
invalid_pixels.zeros: Finite zero DN is not automatically missing; preserve it. An entirely constant/zero required channel or p99<=p1 stops materialization, never replace with an artificial band.

common_contract.never_use_QC_pseudoRGB_order: QC pseudo-RGB maps NIR/red/blue to displayRGB; those PNGs, contact sheets and review assets are never tensors.
common_contract.orientation: Retain north-up/east-left. FITS row order is flipped vertically for array/tensor orientation after world-grid operations. No EXIF/ICC processing applies to FITS.

output.preprocess_numerical_tolerance: float64 reference, final float32 absolute tolerance1e-6 for synthetic conformance tests

common_contract.padding: No letterbox, zero-fill borders, mask channel or variable padding. All source grids square. B requires fully covered crop plus blur/interpolation support; missing support stops materialization.

source_contract.identity: Verify complete byte size and SHA-256 against E on every source read; reject any changed file. Resolve bands by exact E survey ID, not filename colour guesses.
source_contract.master_format: Unmodified primary2D FITS,512x512, FITS BSCALE/BZERO applied in float64
source_contract.ownership: One physical object is one three-band observation. No band, preview, augmentation or derivative becomes an independent labelled observation.

common_contract.validation_test: Same deterministic recipe, intensity rule, orientation, resize and fixed normalization as training; augmentation code always identity. No model/test outcome can change parameters.
